title: Profitable Psychiatric Clinic Equity Stake For Sale in Geneva, Switzerland
tagline: • Integrated outpatient healthcare network headquartered in French-speaking Switzerland, operating 9 clinics and expanding through acquisitions, new clinic openings, and a technology-enabled hub-and-spoke model. • The network operates a multidisciplinary clinic in Geneva covering psychiatry, psychotherapy, and general medicine, serving as the anchor for a broader outpatient healthcare platform. • The high revenue is supported by a scalable hub-and-spoke model, shared technology and back-office infrastructure, and a multidisciplinary network of practitioners serving multiple clinics without duplicating administrative functions at each location. • The business aims to provide a seamless patient journey across its locations through shared booking, telemedicine, a central laboratory, AI-assisted imaging, including 3T MRI and AI-enabled CT at two sites, and corporate wellness services for international organisations and businesses. • The network is positioned to address fragmentation in the Swiss outpatient healthcare market, an ageing population, and unmet demand for mental health services through consolidation under a well-capitalised, long-term owner. • The expansion plan targets more than 25 sites organised into four tiers: expertise centres in Geneva, Lausanne, Neuchâtel, and Dubai; specialised sites in Geneva; neighbourhood satellite clinics; and regional outpatient locations. • The healthcare platform encompasses 11 activity areas: mental health, imaging, surgery and aesthetics, rehabilitation, sleep, longevity, senior care, addiction treatment, VIP and medical concierge services, digital health, and training and research. • Expansion will primarily involve acquiring existing medical practices to establish satellite locations, with new clinic openings pursued where appropriate. The Swiss network serves as the reference model for subsequent country-by-country replication. • The group's technology platform supports billing and back-office operations, while a separate group real estate company owns the clinic premises and leases them to the healthcare network under long-term arrangements. • International expansion is planned across Luxembourg, France, Belgium, Monaco, Spain, Portugal, and the United Arab Emirates, with Dubai serving as a gateway to the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region and international patients. The Dubai healthcare entity is already 60% owned by the group. • The selected markets reflect existing group-company connections, shared languages, and planned business development. Luxembourg is intended to serve as a European Union holding hub and financial centre; France, Belgium, Monaco, and Spain offer French- and Spanish-speaking market opportunities and links to the group's professional-services programme; and Portugal provides a Lusophone gateway to Brazil. • A later expansion phase is planned for Quebec in Canada, Brazil, and the United States. • The healthcare programme forms part of a broader permanent-capital investment platform but can be invested in independently or alongside that platform. Each programme is raised separately through its own special-purpose vehicle (SPV), with co-investors. • The proposed investment is made into a dedicated Swiss public limited company (SA) that holds the healthcare network, including the existing clinics and their patient base, the group's 60% stake in the Dubai healthcare entity, and all new sites acquired or opened using the funds raised. • The investment covers the healthcare operating business rather than the clinic buildings, which remain separately owned by the group's real-estate company and leased to the network. • The proposed investment amount and equity stake are indicative, based on the programme's full deployment across the network, and are not additive to the separate investment opportunity in the broader permanent-capital platform. • Operates with a valid business license and a clinic license.
